_readme: Printosky, Nattika — the counter PC. Finishing/collection store: NO Konica, so konica_ip stays null and B&W prints on the Epson. This box owns printer polling for Nattika (poll_printers true); the office box must leave it false. Epson moved to 192.168.1.250 on 2026-08-18.
_capabilities_readme: What Nattika finishes in-house. Absent or false = outsourced, so a new store never silently claims work it has no machine for (plan §4.7, decision B9).
